calculate.en: Students calculate the average by adding all scores and dividing by the number of tests.
calculate.zh: 學生把所有分數相加，再除以考試次數來計算平均。

calm.en: A calm environment can make it easier to focus on difficult tasks.
calm.zh: 平靜的環境能讓人更容易專注於困難的任務。

campaign.en: The school started a campaign to reduce single-use plastic on campus.
campaign.zh: 學校發起活動，希望減少校園內的一次性塑膠用品。

candidate.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the class election.
candidate.zh: 每位候選人在班級選舉前都發表了簡短演說。

capacity.en: The hall has a capacity of about five hundred people.
capacity.zh: 這座禮堂大約可容納五百人。

capture.en: The camera can capture clear images even in low light.
capture.zh: 這台相機即使在低光環境中也能拍出清楚影像。

career.en: She attended a workshop to learn more about possible career choices.
career.zh: 她參加講座來了解更多可能的職涯選擇。

careful.en: Be careful when carrying glass equipment across the laboratory.
careful.zh: 在實驗室搬運玻璃器材時要小心。

carefully.en: Read the question carefully before choosing your answer.
carefully.zh: 選答案前要仔細閱讀題目。

cause.en: Lack of sleep can cause students to lose concentration in class.
cause.zh: 睡眠不足可能造成學生上課時失去專注力。

celebrate.en: The class will celebrate the end of the semester with a small party.
celebrate.zh: 全班會用一場小聚會慶祝學期結束。

central.en: The library is located in the central part of the campus.
central.zh: 圖書館位於校園中央區域。

century.en: This building has stood here for more than a century.
century.zh: 這棟建築已在這裡矗立超過一個世紀。

certain.en: We need certain information before making the final decision.
certain.zh: 在做最後決定前，我們需要一些特定資訊。

certainly.en: Regular practice will certainly help improve your speaking confidence.
certainly.zh: 規律練習一定有助於提升口說自信。

challenge.en: Learning to manage time is an important challenge for many students.
challenge.zh: 學會管理時間是許多學生的重要挑戰。

chance.en: This activity gives students a chance to practice speaking English.
chance.zh: 這項活動給學生練習說英文的機會。

change.en: A small change in study habits can produce better results.
change.zh: 讀書習慣的小改變可能帶來更好的成果。

channel.en: The school uses an online channel to share important announcements.
channel.zh: 學校使用線上頻道發布重要公告。

character.en: The main character changes greatly by the end of the novel.
character.zh: 小說主角到故事結尾時有很大的改變。

characteristic.en: Patience is an important characteristic of a good researcher.
characteristic.zh: 耐心是優秀研究人員的重要特質。

charge.en: The museum does not charge students for admission on Fridays.
charge.zh: 博物館每週五不向學生收取入場費。

chart.en: The chart shows how the temperature changed during the experiment.
chart.zh: 這張圖表顯示實驗期間溫度的變化。

check.en: Always check your answers before handing in the test.
check.zh: 交卷前一定要檢查答案。

chemical.en: Students wore gloves while handling the chemical in the laboratory.
chemical.zh: 學生在實驗室處理化學物質時戴著手套。

choice.en: Your final choice should depend on the evidence you have collected.
choice.zh: 最後的選擇應根據你蒐集到的證據。

choose.en: Students can choose one topic for their final presentation.
choose.zh: 學生可以選擇一個主題作為期末報告。

circle.en: Draw a circle around the correct answer on the worksheet.
circle.zh: 請在學習單上把正確答案圈起來。

circumstance.en: Under this circumstance, delaying the trip may be the safest option.
circumstance.zh: 在這種情況下，延後旅行可能是最安全的選擇。

citizen.en: Every citizen has a role in protecting the local environment.
citizen.zh: 每位公民都有保護當地環境的責任。

civilization.en: The museum displays objects from an ancient civilization near the river.
civilization.zh: 博物館展示了河流附近古代文明的文物。

climate.en: The island has a warm climate for most of the year.
climate.zh: 這座島大部分時間氣候溫暖。

closely.en: The teacher watched closely as students completed the experiment.
closely.zh: 學生進行實驗時，老師仔細觀察。

combine.en: We can combine the two ideas into one stronger proposal.
combine.zh: 我們可以把這兩個想法結合成一個更好的提案。

comment.en: Please leave a short comment explaining why you chose that answer.
comment.zh: 請留下簡短留言，說明你為何選擇那個答案。

common.en: This is a common mistake among students learning new grammar patterns.
common.zh: 這是學生學習新文法句型時常見的錯誤。

communicate.en: Clear diagrams can help students communicate complex ideas more effectively.
communicate.zh: 清楚的圖示能幫助學生更有效地傳達複雜概念。

community.en: Students joined a community clean-up event on Saturday morning.
community.zh: 學生星期六早上參加了社區清潔活動。

compare.en: Compare the two graphs before writing your conclusion.
compare.zh: 寫結論前先比較這兩張圖表。

complete.en: Please complete the form before the deadline on Friday.
complete.zh: 請在星期五截止日前完成表格。

complex.en: The article explains a complex issue using simple examples.
complex.zh: 這篇文章用簡單例子解釋一個複雜議題。

concentrate.en: It is easier to concentrate when your phone is turned off.
concentrate.zh: 手機關機時比較容易集中注意力。

condition.en: The roads were in poor condition after several days of heavy rain.
condition.zh: 連續幾天大雨後，道路狀況很差。

connect.en: This lesson helps students connect scientific ideas with daily life.
connect.zh: 這堂課幫助學生把科學概念和日常生活連結起來。

consider.en: Please consider both advantages and disadvantages before making a decision.
consider.zh: 做決定前請同時考慮優點和缺點。

constant.en: Constant practice is more useful than studying only before exams.
constant.zh: 持續練習比只在考前讀書更有用。

contact.en: Please contact the teacher if you cannot attend the meeting.
contact.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請聯絡老師。

continue.en: The class will continue the discussion after lunch.
continue.zh: 全班會在午餐後繼續討論。

contrast.en: The essay asks students to contrast city life with country life.
contrast.zh: 這篇作文要求學生比較城市生活和鄉村生活的差異。

contribute.en: Everyone can contribute one idea to improve the group project.
contribute.zh: 每個人都可以提出一個想法來改善小組專題。

control.en: The experiment tests how temperature can control the speed of the reaction.
control.zh: 這個實驗測試溫度如何控制反應速度。

conversation.en: A short conversation can help students practice natural speaking patterns.
conversation.zh: 簡短對話能幫助學生練習自然的口說句型。

correct.en: Check whether each answer is correct before submitting the worksheet.
correct.zh: 提交學習單前要確認每個答案是否正確。

cost.en: The total cost includes transportation, meals, and museum tickets.
cost.zh: 總費用包含交通、餐費和博物館門票。

create.en: Students will create a poster about saving energy at school.
create.zh: 學生會製作一張關於校園節能的海報。

creative.en: The teacher encouraged students to find a creative solution to the problem.
creative.zh: 老師鼓勵學生為這個問題找出有創意的解決方法。

culture.en: Food is an important part of culture in every society.
culture.zh: 食物是每個社會文化的重要部分。

curious.en: Curious students often ask questions that lead to deeper learning.
curious.zh: 好奇的學生常會提出能帶來更深入學習的問題。

current.en: The report summarizes the current situation of public transportation in the city.
current.zh: 這份報告整理了城市大眾運輸的目前狀況。

custom.en: Removing shoes before entering the house is a common custom in some places.
custom.zh: 在某些地方，進屋前脫鞋是一種常見習俗。

damage.en: Strong winds caused damage to several trees near the school.
damage.zh: 強風造成學校附近幾棵樹受損。

danger.en: The warning sign tells visitors about the danger near the cliff.
danger.zh: 警告標誌提醒遊客懸崖附近的危險。

data.en: Accurate data is necessary for drawing a reliable conclusion.
data.zh: 要得出可靠結論，就需要準確資料。

debate.en: The class held a debate about the use of phones at school.
debate.zh: 全班就校園使用手機的議題進行辯論。

decide.en: We will decide the final topic after hearing everyone's ideas.
decide.zh: 聽完每個人的想法後，我們會決定最後主題。

decision.en: The committee made a decision after reviewing all the evidence.
decision.zh: 委員會審查所有證據後做出決定。

decrease.en: Regular maintenance can decrease the risk of equipment failure.
decrease.zh: 定期維護可以降低設備故障的風險。

deep.en: The discussion became deep when students began asking broader questions.
deep.zh: 當學生開始提出更廣泛的問題時，討論變得更深入。

define.en: Please define the key term before giving your example.
define.zh: 舉例前請先定義這個關鍵詞。

degree.en: The temperature increased by one degree during the experiment.
degree.zh: 實驗期間溫度上升了一度。

delay.en: Heavy rain may delay the outdoor event until tomorrow.
delay.zh: 大雨可能使戶外活動延到明天。

demand.en: There is strong demand for faster public transportation in the city.
demand.zh: 城市對更快速的大眾運輸有很高需求。

demonstrate.en: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment before students try it themselves.
demonstrate.zh: 學生自己操作前，老師會先示範這個實驗。

depend.en: Your final score may depend on both tests and class participation.
depend.zh: 你的最後成績可能取決於考試和課堂參與。

describe.en: Use three sentences to describe what happened in the story.
describe.zh: 請用三個句子描述故事中發生的事情。

design.en: The group worked together to design a simple water filter.
design.zh: 小組合作設計了一個簡單的濾水器。

detail.en: One small detail can change the meaning of the whole sentence.
detail.zh: 一個小細節就可能改變整個句子的意思。

determine.en: The test helps determine which material is the strongest.
determine.zh: 這項測試有助於判斷哪種材料最堅固。

develop.en: Reading widely can help students develop stronger writing skills.
develop.zh: 廣泛閱讀能幫助學生培養更好的寫作能力。

difference.en: There is a clear difference between the two methods.
difference.zh: 這兩種方法之間有明顯差異。

difficult.en: The question looks difficult, but it becomes easier after careful analysis.
difficult.zh: 這題看起來很難，但仔細分析後會變得比較容易。

direct.en: The teacher gave direct feedback on the student's first draft.
direct.zh: 老師直接針對學生的初稿提供回饋。

direction.en: The sign shows the direction of the nearest exit.
direction.zh: 這個標誌顯示最近出口的方向。

discover.en: Students may discover new patterns when they organize the data clearly.
discover.zh: 學生把資料整理清楚後，可能會發現新的規律。

discuss.en: We will discuss the article in small groups tomorrow.
discuss.zh: 我們明天會分小組討論這篇文章。

disease.en: The lesson explains how exercise can reduce the risk of disease.
disease.zh: 這堂課說明運動如何降低疾病風險。

distance.en: The distance from the station to the school is about two kilometers.
distance.zh: 車站到學校的距離大約兩公里。

divide.en: Divide the class into four groups before starting the activity.
divide.zh: 活動開始前，把全班分成四組。

document.en: Save the document before closing the computer program.
document.zh: 關閉電腦程式前要先儲存文件。

double.en: The number of participants may double if registration remains open.
double.zh: 如果持續開放報名，參與人數可能會增加一倍。

doubt.en: There is little doubt that practice improves performance over time.
doubt.zh: 長期而言，練習能提升表現幾乎沒有疑問。

draft.en: Write a first draft before you begin revising the essay.
draft.zh: 開始修改作文前，先寫出第一版草稿。

draw.en: Draw a simple diagram to show how the system works.
draw.zh: 請畫一個簡單圖示，說明這個系統如何運作。

drive.en: It takes about twenty minutes to drive from school to the station.
drive.zh: 從學校開車到車站大約需要二十分鐘。

drop.en: The temperature can drop quickly after sunset in the mountains.
drop.zh: 山區日落後氣溫可能快速下降。

during.en: Please remain quiet during the listening section of the exam.
during.zh: 考試聽力部分進行時請保持安靜。
